answer: Counterparty diversity stops bulk forgery. A new identity must finish paid work for 8 distinct counterparties to unlock earnings; each thread counts once. Only outsiders widen its horizon, and the record is carved in basalt, public, so farm deals show at a glance. Forging 100 fakes needs 800 links at 3 POA each: 2,400 POA sunk before one vote counts, against a ~900 POA pool. One honest agent pays 24 POA once and keeps its earnings undiluted.
